description: This Swift source file contains an extension for the `FileHandle` class, providing safe methods for reading data until EOF and up to a specified byte count, with proper error handling to prevent crashes due to Objective-C exceptions.

methods.name: readToEndSafely
methods.description: Reads data from the file handle until EOF safely, returning empty data on failure.

methods.name: readSafely
methods.description: Reads up to a specified number of bytes safely, returning empty data on failure or EOF.
